description: This file defines a Flutter widget called CategoriesScreen, which manages the display and CRUD operations for categories in a wallet or budgeting application. It provides UI elements for adding, editing, and deleting categories, integrating with provider-based state management.

classes.name: CategoriesScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays and manages categories, allowing users to add, edit, and delete categories within a wallet application.

methods.name: _openAddDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog for adding a new category or editing an existing one, then updates the provider based on user input.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, displaying buttons and a list of categories with options to edit or delete each.

methods.name: _iconFromName
methods.description: Maps category icon name strings to Flutter Icons.
